CodeSystem
Retrieves a list of code systems

params.name: auth
params.description: basic access authentication credentials, specified as username:password and encoded using Base64 encoding. These credentials can alternatively be passed in the 'Authorization: Basic' HTTP header.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the code system. By default, this filter matches a code system if its name equals or starts with the supplied parameter value. Also supports the :contains and :exact modifiers.

params.name: _sort
params.description: Indicates which order to return the results. Terminology Gateway currently only supports sorting on a single field, not chained sort rules.

params.name: _pretty
params.description: Non-standard parameter to request that responses be pretty-printed.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of code systems matching the provided search criteria.
